newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni wins 42 bln yen Thai power order.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni wins 42 bln yen Thai power order.

text.p: Major Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp said on Friday it had won a 42 billion yen order from Thailand's Cogeneration Public Co to build an electric power plant in Thailand.
The power plant, which is expected to be completed in April 1999, will have a generating capacity of 230 megawatts, a company spokesman said.
Marubeni will also build a paper bag factory for packaging petrochemical products such as nylon and polyester in Thailand, the spokesman said.
The factory will start operating in April 1998 and produce one million bags per month, he said.
